opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants

amount.raw: Payments made as reimbursements of expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors (no fixed amount stated)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications under category A should be submitted to the Society's Administrator; applications under category B should be discussed with the relevant Series Editor. Recipients of support need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: The Hakluyt Society supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or for research on proposals already approved where volumes are under contract to the Society. Payments are made as reimbursements of expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors, funded from the Society's Harry & Grace Smith Fund. Expenditure is eligible under two categories: (A) research in support of preparing publication projects for submission to the Society; and (B) research towards completion of publication projects approved and under contract for publication. Research may relate to the Society's main series (Series III) or to the Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel series.
